answer: An operator running 74 keys as a result pays for 74 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the lotus quota and the cedar admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the garden ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 7 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole army of identities at once. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
